summary: This directory serves as the dedicated testing suite for verifying the structural definitions and schemas of document elements. It ensures that various document components like bullet lists, code blocks, and tables conform to expected formats and behaviors before they are used in the application.
responsibilities: Verify the integrity and schema of document element definitions
Validate that document components maintain consistent structure
Test individual element specifications to ensure correct rendering data
relationships: The directory contains test suites that validate the definition logic for specific document elements.
Each test ensures that the structural definition of an element meets the requirements defined by the application domain.
designDecisions: Collocation of tests with their respective domain definitions to maintain test proximity
Separation of concerns by isolating element definition tests within a distinct test-specific directory
